title: Working beside Hunt's CIA colleague Arthur Hawkberg in Queens
place_text: Queens, New York; Robert Mullen Corporation, Washington, DC

tellings.quote: turns out to have been EH Howard Hunt's colleague at the the front that they worked for in Washington, DC.

plain: Around 1979 the writer Peter Levenda worked in Queens, New York, beside a man named Arthur Hawkberg who, he later learned, had been a colleague of the CIA officer E. Howard Hunt at a Washington firm, the Robert Mullen Corporation, that Levenda calls a front. Levenda tells it from his own experience, saying Hawkberg "turns out to have been E. Howard Hunt's colleague," which would put him a step away from the intelligence world without knowing it.
